label: I buy snacks or coffee almost every day
tip: Bring snacks and a refillable bottle from home on weekdays and keep café visits for one day a week.
action: Set a weekly snack limit of $10.

label: I pay for more than one streaming or gaming subscription
tip: Keep one subscription and rotate to another only after cancelling the first.
action: Check every subscription on the first of the month.

label: I order food delivery several times a week
tip: Delivery fees and tips can add a third to the price. Cook in batches with friends twice a week instead.
action: Limit delivery to one weekend treat.

label: I buy things when I see a sale
tip: A sale only saves money if you planned to buy the item anyway. Wait 48 hours before any sale purchase.
action: Unfollow sale alerts and remove saved cards from apps.

label: I take ride-hailing cabs for short trips
tip: A student bus pass or sharing rides with classmates usually costs far less than daily cabs.
action: Plan trips the night before so you are not rushing.

label: I spend most of my allowance in the first two weeks
tip: Split your wants money into four weekly amounts so the last two weeks are covered too.
action: Move savings aside the day your allowance arrives.

label: I buy new textbooks every semester
tip: Used copies, library loans and digital editions often cost half as much.
action: Ask seniors for their books before the semester starts.

label: I don't track what I spend
tip: You can't fix what you can't see. Logging every purchase for one month shows where money leaks.
action: Try the Expense Planner for a week of sample entries.
